one_line_pitch: Evidence-gated document execution for high-stakes business workflows
submission_line: Nutrient DWS turns messy source documents into source-grounded structured evidence and provides the review surface where humans resolve facts the automation is not allowed to guess.
acceptance_gate: A judge must see a real extracted value, jump to source evidence, see a material mismatch routed to review, resolve it, and watch the downstream workflow unblock.

criteria.description: Real Nutrient DWS Data Extraction API call on actual PDF documents
criteria.pass_condition: At least 5 facts extracted with extractor='nutrient_dws' in response
criteria.fail_condition: Zero facts returned or extractor is not 'nutrient_dws'
criteria.sponsor_quote: must use Nutrient DWS ... for at least one core document operation, meaningfully
criteria.demo_script_step: 0:20-0:55 — Show extraction results with fact count and confidence scores

criteria.description: Each extracted fact retains value + page number + source document reference
criteria.pass_condition: Every fact has non-null value_raw, doc_id, and page fields
criteria.fail_condition: Any fact missing page or doc_id
criteria.demo_script_step: 0:30 — Click insurance expiry fact, show source document + page number

criteria.description: Provenance is never discarded — original value_raw preserved alongside normalized value

check_params.condition: value_raw != value_normalized for at least 2 facts

criteria.pass_condition: At least 2 facts where value_raw differs from value_normalized (e.g. '$42,500' vs '42500')
criteria.fail_condition: All facts have identical raw and normalized values
criteria.demo_script_step: 0:35 — Show 'Northstar Data Systems Ltd.' raw vs 'Northstar Data Systems Ltd' normalized

criteria.description: Low-confidence or conflicting material facts are routed to human review
criteria.pass_condition: Case state becomes REVIEW_REQUIRED with at least 1 BLOCKER assertion
criteria.fail_condition: Case goes directly to APPROVABLE without review
criteria.sponsor_quote: Route low-confidence/conflicting material facts to review
criteria.demo_script_step: 0:55-1:20 — Show insurance date mismatch routed to review queue

criteria.description: Nutrient DWS Viewer is embedded in the UI showing source document context
criteria.pass_condition: DWS Viewer renders source PDF with highlighted extracted region
criteria.fail_condition: No viewer embedded or viewer shows placeholder
criteria.demo_script_step: 0:30 — Click source chip, DWS Viewer opens at extraction location

criteria.description: Clicking an exception opens its source context in the viewer
criteria.pass_condition: Click on insurance date exception navigates viewer to insurance cert page
criteria.fail_condition: Click does not open viewer or opens wrong location
criteria.sponsor_quote: Clicking an exception opens its source context
criteria.demo_script_step: 0:40 — Click insurance expiry exception, viewer jumps to certificate page

criteria.description: Human resolution creates a new audit event; original extraction stays immutable
criteria.pass_condition: EXCEPTION_RESOLVED event exists AND original facts are unchanged
criteria.fail_condition: Facts modified during resolution or no audit event created
criteria.sponsor_quote: Human resolution becomes a new event; original extraction stays immutable
criteria.demo_script_step: 1:20-1:45 — Resolve exception, show audit event, show original facts unchanged

criteria.description: One-line statement: where DWS did the heavy lifting
criteria.pass_condition: README contains explicit attribution to Nutrient DWS
criteria.fail_condition: No mention of Nutrient in README
criteria.sponsor_quote: one-line 'where DWS did the heavy lifting'
